about.first: I'm a full-stack engineer in London who likes owning a product from the first user conversation to the release.
paragraphs: After an MSc in Health Psychology and a published paper on how people accept AI in healthcare, I taught myself to code. I built a hackathon project that I later sold on Flippa, freelanced, then joined Printerpix, where I migrated two undocumented legacy systems on my own.
In 2026 I left to build Owlex, a trading card scanner that recognises cards on the phone.
I work AI-native. I've spent more than 1,500 hours in Claude Code, shipping whole products with it that hold up in production. People also bring me their vibe-coded projects to clean up.
I'm most interested in health tech and AI products.

facts.label: Main stack
facts.value: TypeScript, React, Next.js, React Native, Python, Postgres

highlights: Designed, built and shipped a React Native app that scans, identifies, prices and lists trading cards to eBay across five games. I own the mobile app, the Next.js API, Supabase/Postgres and the ML pipeline.

Trained a two-stage recognition system (YOLOX detector, ArcFace embeddings, pgvector search) that reaches 91% top-1 and 99.1% top-5 accuracy on about 10,000 hand-labelled cards, in real time on the phone through TFLite.
Built the training data pipeline: scraped real-world card photos from Reddit and eBay, auto-labelled them with Grounding DINO and removed duplicates with perceptual hashing.
Ran user research at an official TCG trading show and a beta with 15+ collectors, then reworked scanning and pricing from what they told me.
Integrated eBay listing (OAuth and the Inventory API), cache-first market pricing and RevenueCat subscriptions.

Rebuilt the e-commerce admin platform that runs product setup, pricing, content and orders for nine international storefronts, moving an undocumented ASP.NET MVC application to Next.js and TypeScript on my own.
Migrated Project Check, the order-inspection tool customer support uses every day, to Qwik. I covered the UI, the API and the SQL.
Wrote a private S3 uploader package on CEPH that replaced UploadCare and cut storage costs.
Added Playwright end-to-end tests ahead of peak trading periods.
Built the first version of a booking platform for beauty businesses with Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB and Better Auth.
Designed the scheduling algorithm that finds the best time slots across several staff members.
Came back in 2025 to add multi-tenancy with Payload CMS and role-based access, plus per-client booking pages generated with ISR and sold as a premium feature.
Python automation scripts for clients, with a 100% satisfaction rate.
Extended a Django front end for a startup that verifies social and environmental impact data, working with a remote international team.
